The decoder interprets entry offsets as signed 16-bit word offsets and reads glyphs from `max(0, ceil(substOffset / 2) - offset)` up to `min(numGlyphs, floor(size / 2) - offset)`. This includes every glyph whose replacement word is wholly within the substitution table and subtable, for either sign of offset; the new subtable reader also bounds decoding to that subtable’s bytes.
